scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
Would you like to enter the Monster Arena?
Currently ^FF0000{0}^000000 players
^FF0000Note:^000000 Pecos, Falcons and Carts will be lost on entry.
scripts.translation:
[怪物竞技场]
您想进入怪物竞技场吗？
当前有^FF0000{0}^000000名玩家。
^FF0000注意：^000000入场后，大嘴鸟、猎鹰和手推车都会消失。
进入
了解规则
取消

[怪物竞技场]
欢迎随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
You must purchase a pet from the Monster Tamer to start fighting.
scripts.translation:
[怪物竞技场]
您必须先从怪物驯养师那里购买一只宠物，才能开始战斗。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
Then talk to the Usher and tell him you would like to compete.
scripts.translation:
[怪物竞技场]
然后找引座员，告诉他您想参赛。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
Talk to the referee to summon your monster.
Once your monster has fought, you must talk to the Usher again and choose to spectate.
scripts.translation:
[怪物竞技场]
去找裁判召唤您的魔物。
魔物战斗结束后，您必须再次找引座员，并选择观战。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
Talk to the Monster Trainer, he will ask you to heal your pet.
scripts.translation:
[怪物竞技场]
去找怪物驯养师，他会让您先治疗宠物。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
To do this, click the Nurse repeatedly until it says your pet is healed.
scripts.translation:
[怪物竞技场]
反复点击护士，直到她提示您的宠物已经痊愈。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
The more monsters you kill, the more exp you get and the quicker you can upgrade.
scripts.translation:
[怪物竞技场]
击败的魔物越多，获得的经验值就越多，升级也就越快。

scripts.text:
[Monster Arena]
The stronger your monster is, the longer it will take to summon again.
scripts.translation:
[怪物竞技场]
您的魔物越强，再次召唤所需的时间就越长。
